shout.skycraft.animal_allegiance.desc: A Shout for help from the beasts of the wild, who come to fight in your defense.
shout.skycraft.aura_whisper.desc: Your Voice is not a shout, but a whisper, revealing the life forces of any and all.
shout.skycraft.become_ethereal.desc: The Thu'um reaches out to the Void, changing your form to one that cannot be harmed - or harm.
shout.skycraft.clear_skies.desc: Skyrim itself yields before the Thu'um, as you clear away fog and inclement weather.
shout.skycraft.disarm.desc: Shout defies steel, as you rip the weapon from an opponent's grasp.
shout.skycraft.dragonrend.desc: Your Voice lashes out at a dragon's very soul, forcing the beast to land.
shout.skycraft.elemental_fury.desc: The Thu'um imbues your arms with the speed of wind, allowing for faster weapon strikes.
shout.skycraft.fire_breath.desc: Inhale air, exhale flame, and behold the Thu'um as inferno.
shout.skycraft.frost_breath.desc: Your breath is winter, your Thu'um a blizzard.
shout.skycraft.kynes_peace.desc: The Voice soothes wild beasts, who lose their will to fight.
shout.skycraft.marked_for_death.desc: Speak, and let your Voice herald doom, as an opponent's armor is lowered and life force drained.
shout.skycraft.slow_time.desc: Shout at time, and command it to obey, slowing all around you.
shout.skycraft.storm_call.desc: A Shout to the skies, a cry to the clouds, that awakens the destructive force of the storm.
shout.skycraft.unrelenting_force.desc: Your Voice is raw power, pushing aside anything - or anyone - who stands in your path.
shout.skycraft.whirlwind_sprint.desc: The Thu'um rushes forward, carrying you in its wake with the speed of a tempest.
spell.skycraft.blizzard.desc: Hold to charge, then summon a freezing storm around you that does 25 points of frost damage per second for 12 seconds.
spell.skycraft.bound_battleaxe.desc: Creates a magic battleaxe for 120 seconds.
spell.skycraft.bound_bow.desc: Creates a magic bow for 120 seconds. Its arrows are conjured as you draw.
spell.skycraft.bound_sword.desc: Creates a magic sword for 120 seconds. Sheathe it to dispel it.
spell.skycraft.calm.desc: Creatures and people up to a moderate level won't fight for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.candlelight.desc: Creates a hovering light that follows the caster for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning that does 40 points of shock damage and then leaps to two more targets nearby.
spell.skycraft.conjure_dremora_lord.desc: Hold to charge, then summon a Dremora Lord for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.conjure_familiar.desc: Summons a spectral wolf to fight for you for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.conjure_flame_atronach.de: Summons a Flame Atronach for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.conjure_frost_atronach.de: Summons a Frost Atronach for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.conjure_storm_atronach.de: Summons a Storm Atronach for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.courage.desc: The ally you aim at (or your summoned allies) won't flee and fight harder for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.detect_life.desc: Nearby living creatures, but not the undead or constructs, can be seen through walls for 15 seconds.
spell.skycraft.ebonyflesh.desc: Improves the caster's armor rating by 100 points for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.fear.desc: Creatures and people up to a moderate level flee from combat for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.fire_storm.desc: Hold to charge, then unleash a massive explosion of fire around you, doing 100 points of damage to nearby targets.
spell.skycraft.fireball.desc: A fiery explosion for 40 points of damage in a 4 block radius. Targets on fire take extra damage. Never harms the land.
spell.skycraft.firebolt.desc: A blast of fire that does 25 points of damage. Targets on fire take extra damage.
spell.skycraft.flames.desc: A gout of fire that does 8 points of fire damage per second. Targets on fire take extra damage.
spell.skycraft.frenzy.desc: Creatures and people in the target area attack anything nearby for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.frostbite.desc: A blast of cold that does 8 points of frost damage per second to Health and Stamina, and slows the target.
spell.skycraft.fury.desc: Creatures and people up to a low level will attack anything nearby for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.grand_healing.desc: Heals you and everyone nearby 200 points.
spell.skycraft.guardian_circle.desc: Hold to charge, then create a circle that heals allies inside 20 points per second and burns and repels the undead for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.harmony.desc: Hold to charge, then calm every creature and person around you for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.heal_other.desc: Heals the target 25 points per second, but not the undead or constructs.
spell.skycraft.healing.desc: Heals the caster 10 points per second.
spell.skycraft.ice_spike.desc: A spike of ice that does 25 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina, and slows the target.
spell.skycraft.ice_storm.desc: A freezing whirlwind that does 40 points of frost damage per second to Health and Stamina of everything it passes through.
spell.skycraft.icy_spear.desc: A spear of ice that does 60 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
spell.skycraft.incinerate.desc: A blast of fire that does 60 points of damage. Targets on fire take extra damage.
spell.skycraft.invisibility.desc: Caster is invisible for 30 seconds. Attacking ends the effect.
spell.skycraft.ironflesh.desc: Improves the caster's armor rating by 80 points for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.lesser_ward.desc: While held, a ward in front of you absorbs up to 40 points of spell damage.
spell.skycraft.lightning_bolt.desc: A bolt of lightning that does 25 points of shock damage to Health and half to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.lightning_storm.desc: Hold to charge, then keep holding: a massive beam of lightning does 75 points of shock damage per second to Health, and half that to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.mass_paralysis.desc: Hold to charge, then paralyze every creature in the target area for 15 seconds.
spell.skycraft.mayhem.desc: Hold to charge, then drive every creature and person around you into a frenzy for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.muffle.desc: You move more quietly and are harder to detect for 180 seconds.
spell.skycraft.oakflesh.desc: Improves the caster's armor rating by 40 points for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.pacify.desc: Creatures and people in the target area won't fight for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.paralyze.desc: Targets that fail to resist are paralyzed for 10 seconds.
spell.skycraft.raise_zombie.desc: Aimed at a weak body, raises it to fight for you for 60 seconds. With no body in sight, a zombie rises from the earth.
spell.skycraft.rally.desc: Allies around you won't flee and fight harder for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.soul_trap.desc: If the target dies within 60 seconds, its soul fills an empty soul gem you carry.
spell.skycraft.sparks.desc: Lightning that does 8 points of shock damage per second to Health, and half that to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.stoneflesh.desc: Improves the caster's armor rating by 60 points for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.thunderbolt.desc: A thunderbolt that does 60 points of shock damage to Health and half to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.transmute.desc: Transmutes one piece of iron (ingot, raw iron or ore) you carry into gold.
spell.skycraft.turn_lesser_undead.desc: Undead up to a low level flee for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.waterbreathing.desc: You can breathe underwater for 60 seconds.
tooltip.skycraft.bound_weapon: Conjured: vanishes when dropped or stored
tooltip.skycraft.spell_charged: Master spell: hold the cast key to charge
tooltip.skycraft.spell_tome_hint: Use to learn this spell, then equip or favorite it in the magic menu
spell.skycraft.fire_rune.desc: Cast on a nearby surface, the rune explodes for 50 points of fire damage when an enemy comes near.
spell.skycraft.frost_rune.desc: Cast on a nearby surface, the rune explodes for 50 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina when an enemy comes near.
spell.skycraft.lightning_rune.desc: Cast on a nearby surface, the rune explodes for 50 points of shock damage to Health and half to Magicka when an enemy comes near.
spell.skycraft.flame_cloak.desc: For 60 seconds, enemies close to you take 8 points of fire damage per second. Targets on fire take extra damage.
spell.skycraft.frost_cloak.desc: For 60 seconds, enemies close to you take 8 points of frost damage per second, plus Stamina damage.
spell.skycraft.lightning_cloak.desc: For 60 seconds, enemies close to you take 10 points of shock damage per second, and half that to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.wall_of_flames.desc: Hold to set the ground you aim at ablaze: anything crossing the flames takes 50 points of fire damage per second.
spell.skycraft.wall_of_frost.desc: Hold to raise a wall of frost where you aim: 50 points of frost damage per second to Health and Stamina, and it slows.
spell.skycraft.wall_of_storms.desc: Hold to raise a wall of lightning where you aim: 60 points of shock damage per second, and half that to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.healing_hands.desc: Heals the target 10 points per second, but not the undead or constructs.
spell.skycraft.steadfast_ward.desc: While held, a ward in front of you absorbs up to 60 points of spell damage.
spell.skycraft.greater_ward.desc: While held, a ward in front of you absorbs up to 80 points of spell damage.
spell.skycraft.sun_fire.desc: A blast of sunlight that does 25 points of damage; the undead take twice as much and catch fire.
spell.skycraft.repel_lesser_undead.desc: Undead up to a moderate level in the target area flee for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.turn_undead.desc: Undead up to a moderate level flee for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.stendarrs_aura.desc: For 60 seconds, undead close to you take 20 points of sun damage per second.
spell.skycraft.circle_of_protection.desc: A circle on the ground that undead up to a high level can't enter for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.repel_undead.desc: Undead up to a high level in the target area flee for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.turn_greater_undead.desc: Undead up to a high level flee for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.bane_of_the_undead.desc: Hold to charge, then every undead around you up to a very high level catches fire and flees for 30 seconds.
item.skycraft.spell_tome_bane_of_the_und: Spell Tome: Bane of the Undead
spell.skycraft.vampires_bane.desc: Hold to charge, then a burst of sunlight does 40 points of damage around you; the undead take twice as much.
spell.skycraft.magelight.desc: A ball of light that sticks where it lands and lights the area for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.detect_dead.desc: Nearby undead can be seen through walls for 15 seconds.
spell.skycraft.equilibrium.desc: Converts 25 points of Health into 25 points of Magicka.
spell.skycraft.ash_shell.desc: Targets up to a fair level are encased in ash for 15 seconds: they can't move, act or be harmed.
spell.skycraft.dragonhide.desc: Hold to charge, then ignore 80% of all physical damage for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.bound_dagger.desc: Creates a magic dagger for 120 seconds.
spell.skycraft.reanimate_corpse.desc: Aimed at a body of moderate strength, raises it to fight for you for 60 seconds. With no body in sight, calls an undead from the earth.
spell.skycraft.revenant.desc: Aimed at a fairly strong body, raises it to fight for you for 60 seconds. With no body in sight, a revenant rises.
spell.skycraft.dread_zombie.desc: Aimed at a strong body, raises it to fight for you for 60 seconds. With no body in sight, a dread zombie rises.
spell.skycraft.dead_thrall.desc: Hold to charge, then raise almost any body as a permanent thrall that stays until it is killed or you leave.
spell.skycraft.flaming_familiar.desc: Summons a burning wolf for 60 seconds. It sets what it bites on fire and explodes when its time is up.
spell.skycraft.conjure_seeker.desc: Summons a Seeker, a servant of Hermaeus Mora, for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.banish_daedra.desc: Summoned Daedra up to a high level are sent back to Oblivion.
spell.skycraft.command_daedra.desc: A summoned or wild Daedra fights for you for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.flame_thrall.desc: Hold to charge, then summon a permanent Flame Atronach. It stays until it is killed or you leave.
spell.skycraft.frost_thrall.desc: Hold to charge, then summon a permanent Frost Atronach. It stays until it is killed or you leave.
spell.skycraft.storm_thrall.desc: Hold to charge, then summon a permanent Storm Atronach. It stays until it is killed or you leave.
spell.skycraft.clairvoyance.desc: While held, a trail of light shows the way to your current objective, or to the nearest town.
spell.skycraft.rout.desc: Creatures and people up to a high level in the target area flee for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.call_to_arms.desc: Hold to charge, then allies around you fight harder, take less damage and have more health for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.hysteria.desc: Hold to charge, then creatures and people around you flee in terror for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.telekinesis.desc: Hold to pull a distant item to you; let go to throw it at whatever stands in front of you.
spell.skycraft.detect_life_mysticism.des: Every living thing nearby, the undead included, can be seen through walls for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.soul_trap_mysticism.desc: If the target dies within 60 seconds, its soul fills an empty soul gem you carry.
spell.skycraft.slowfall.desc: You fall as gently as a feather for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.dispel.desc: Removes harmful magic from you. Dual cast, it also cleanses your allies nearby.
spell.skycraft.water_walking.desc: You can walk on water for 120 seconds. Sneak to sink.
spell.skycraft.absorb_health.desc: Drains 8 points of Health per second from the target into you.
spell.skycraft.absorb_stamina.desc: Drains 10 points of Stamina per second from the target into you.
spell.skycraft.absorb_magicka.desc: Drains 10 points of Magicka per second from the target into you.
spell.skycraft.mark.desc: Marks the spot where you stand. Cast Recall to return to it.
spell.skycraft.recall.desc: Returns you to the spot you marked with Mark.
spell.skycraft.divine_intervention.desc: Carries you to the nearest temple of the Nine Divines: a capital or city outside Morrowind.
spell.skycraft.almsivi_intervention.desc: Carries you to the nearest temple of the Tribunal, in a town of Morrowind.
spell.skycraft.reflect_spell.desc: For 30 seconds, a 30% chance to send hostile spells back at their caster.
spell.skycraft.spell_absorption.desc: For 30 seconds, a 30% chance to absorb hostile spells as Magicka.
spell.skycraft.levitate.desc: You can fly slowly for 30 seconds, never far above the ground.
spell.skycraft.telekinetic_hurl.desc: A burst of force that does 50 points of damage and flings the target, and those beside it, through the air.
spell.skycraft.spell_turning.desc: For 30 seconds, a 50% chance to reflect hostile spells and a 25% chance to absorb them.
spell.skycraft.mass_dispel.desc: Hold to charge, then cleanse your allies around you, strip your enemies of their magic and banish their summons.
shout.skycraft.ice_form.desc: Your Thu'um freezes those before you solid in a shell of ice.
shout.skycraft.throw_voice.desc: Your Voice echoes from a distant place, and your foes go to see what made it.
shout.skycraft.dismay.desc: A Shout of terror that sends weaker foes running.
shout.skycraft.call_dragon.desc: Call upon Odahviing, who comes to fight at your side. Needs all three words and an open sky.
shout.skycraft.call_of_valor.desc: A hero of Sovngarde answers your Voice and fights at your side for 60 seconds.
shout.skycraft.cyclone.desc: A whirlwind leaps from your Voice and sweeps foes off their feet.
shout.skycraft.drain_vitality.desc: Your Voice saps the Stamina, then the Magicka and at last the Health of those before you.
shout.skycraft.soul_tear.desc: All three words tear at a foe's soul; if it dies soon after, it rises as your thrall.
shout.skycraft.bend_will.desc: Your Voice bends the will of creatures, then people, and finally dragons, to fight for you.
shout.skycraft.dragon_aspect.desc: Take on the aspect of a dragon: tougher hide, heavier blows, less damage taken and a Voice that recovers faster.
shout.skycraft.battle_fury.desc: Your Voice fills your allies with fury: they strike faster and harder.
magic.skycraft.made_spell_hint: A spell of your own making. Press X to forget it.
message.skycraft.call_dragon_none: Your call echoes across the sky, but no dragon answers
message.skycraft.call_dragon_weak: You need all three words to call a dragon
message.skycraft.clairvoyance_nothing: There is nothing for you to find
message.skycraft.corpse_too_powerful: That body is too powerful for this spell
message.skycraft.dragon_aspect_active: You already wear the aspect of a dragon
message.skycraft.mark_other_world: Your mark lies in another world (the Anchor perk lets you return across worlds)
message.skycraft.no_mark: You haven't marked a place to return to
message.skycraft.rune_no_surface: There's no surface close enough for a rune
message.skycraft.soul_tear_weak: Soul Tear needs all three words
message.skycraft.too_weak: You are too weak to cast that
message.skycraft.undead_too_strong: These undead are too powerful to repel
message.skycraft.word_learned_hint: You learned a Word of %s. Slay a dragon and absorb its soul to unlock it (magic menu: %s).
message.skycraft.word_learned_hint_soul: You learned a Word of %s. Spend a dragon soul to unlock it in the magic menu (%s).
spellmaking.skycraft.help: Click a magic effect on the left to add it to your new spell. A spell holds up to four effects; each has a range (Self, Touch or Target), a magnitude, a duration and an area. Its school is that of its most costly effect.
spellmaking.skycraft.hint: Shift-click an arrow to step by 10
spellmaking.skycraft.name: Spell name
spellmaking.skycraft.no_effects: You know no magic effects yet. Learn spells from tomes first: each spell teaches its effect.
spellmaking.skycraft.problem.gold: You can't afford the altar's fee
spellmaking.skycraft.problem.name: Give your spell a name (letters, digits and spaces)
spellmaking.skycraft.problem.unknown_eff: You don't know one of those effects
spellmaking.skycraft.problem.skill: Your %s must be %s to make a spell this powerful
spellmaking.skycraft.problem.too_many: You know too many spells of your own; forget one first (X in the magic menu)
